summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a scientific poster presented at the 2026 MDS Congress in Seoul describing post-hoc analyses of the ATH434-201 Phase 2 trial in Multiple System Atrophy. No transaction, shareholder action, or corporate event is disclosed; the filing is a routine disclosure of clinical data by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US Form 8-K furnished under Item 7.01/8.01. The exhibit reports that ATH434 50 mg slowed functional decline roughly 52% versus placebo on UMSARS Part I at Week 52 with baseline CSF NfL as covariate, and that CSF NfL predicted decline. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle exist; no special-situation catalyst is presented.
